nub--nub-habano.description: Rolled at Oliva's Estelí factory, Nub Habano is an all-Nicaraguan blend under a Habano wrapper, cut short and thick so the smoke reaches its fuller flavours almost at once. Reviewers find charred wood, cedar and pepper early, a nutty, earthy middle and a drier, peppery close.

thirds.notes: Toasted wood and cedar lead, with a firm pepper bite, a little natural sweetness and a roasted nut note.
The profile turns nuttier and more earthy, with a hint of cocoa and soft leather as the spice keeps rising.
Sweetness recedes; earth, oak-like wood and leather take over, pepper sharpens on the retrohale and the nicotine climbs.

nub--nub-connecticut.description: Part of the short, wide Nub range that Oliva launched in 2008, this version wraps Nicaraguan binder and filler in Ecuadorian Connecticut shade leaf. Reviewers place it between mild and medium: a soft, bready and creamy smoke with earth, light pepper and a gentle natural sweetness.

thirds.notes: Opens on earth and gentle pepper, with a buttery, bready softness and a touch of cedar as natural sweetness comes through.
Earth and pepper grow a little more intense, joined by a creamy custard tone and the faint bitterness typical of shade leaf.
The smoke lightens again, with cinnamon-like spice, soft leather and a cereal sweetness to finish.

nub--nub-maduro.description: Nub Maduro is made at Tabacalera Oliva de Estelí, pairing a Brazilian maduro wrapper with Nicaraguan binder and filler in Oliva's stubby Nub format. The smoke stays smooth for a maduro, moving from dark sweetness and coffee through chocolate and walnut towards a peppery, earthy finish.

thirds.notes: A dark, sweet start with chocolate and earth, light pepper and black coffee on the finish.
Sweetness settles into the background as coffee, dark chocolate, walnut and dry cedar take the lead.
Pepper, earth and coffee deepen, with walnut and a buttery note; the retrohale grows spicier towards the end.

nub--nub-cameroon.description: Created by Sam Leccia and produced by the Oliva family from 2008, Nub Cameroon wraps Nicaraguan binder and filler in African Cameroon leaf, rolled short and thick at Oliva's Estelí factory. It smokes smooth and oily, with leather, nuts and a quick spice that builds slowly through the medium range.

thirds.notes: Leather and nuts with a mild pepper edge; the smoke feels thick and buttery and the spice flashes briefly in the nose.
Spice moves to the front, with a light citrus-zest note and a clean, peppery finish as the body builds.
Leather deepens, joined by earth, cocoa, nut and wood, with a spicy aftertaste on the retrohale.
